caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic pitcher with a wide body, a pronounced spout, and a squared handle. The pitcher has a predominantly white or light gray surface with soft shading to indicate its rounded form. Around its body, there is a decorative gold motif featuring leaves and curved lines, interspersed with clusters of small blue and purple flowers, each flower containing a red dot in the center. The rim of the pitcher, both at the top opening and around the base, is highlighted with a gold stripe. The interior of the pitcher is also depicted with pale blue shading to suggest depth. The overall composition centers the pitcher against a plain off-white background, and the artist’s signature, "FRANCES LICHTEN," appears in small letters to the lower right of the pitcher.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
